opportunities.title: Institutional Engagement Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be supported by a Society Representative or a Fellow; open to Society Representatives and members.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding to support Society Representatives and members to host events at their organisation, including internal conferences, teaching symposia, seminars or outreach events. Funding cannot be used for salary costs, attending conferences or membership payments.

opportunities.title: Unlocking Futures Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to postdoctoral researchers (members) who require additional support to achieve their full potential.
opportunities.summary: Provides additional support to postdoctoral researchers to help them achieve their full potential. Funds may be used for consumables, registration for Higher Education Academy Fellowship or other fully justified sundries; cannot be used for staff salaries.

opportunities.title: Education and Teaching Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to members; host institution must be willing to administer the award.
opportunities.summary: Supports members wishing to develop new educational resources or conduct a piece of publishable educational research addressing a key question in physiological education. Applications for 2026 closed; reopen in autumn 2026.

opportunities.title: Research and Knowledge Exchange Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to members; host institution must be willing to administer the award.
opportunities.summary: Supports members wishing to conduct pilot studies, develop a new technique or finalise a project, as well as activities to promote knowledge transfer and impact. Applications for 2026 closed; reopen in autumn 2026.

opportunities.title: Equity, Diversity and Inclusion Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to Undergraduate & Masters, Postgraduate, Full members or Fellows of the Physiological Society in their second year of membership or longer.
opportunities.summary: Provides support for Members to run activities that address Equity, Diversity and Inclusion principles in the physiological sciences, in teaching or research. Applications closed for 2026; reopen in 2027.

opportunities.title: Conference Attendance Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to members (Undergraduate & Masters, Postgraduate, Full and Fellow); applicants must be submitting/presenting an abstract at the meeting they wish to attend.
opportunities.summary: Supports member engagement at Society meetings and Society-sponsored events, covering registration and a contribution toward advanced standard travel and accommodation.
